Resolves #19557

The 13.2 notes now tell the cross-window drag by the rule the release ships, and they carry the merges through `c09b6c7107`. § *Green in emulation, broken by hand* used to end on the pointer park. It now ends on #19539's rule: the window that claims the pointer carries the drag as its tab-header proxy, the vessel retires, leaving opens a fresh vessel, and only a native title-bar drop parks. The September repairs stay as history, in the past tense where their mechanism was retired. #19556 (Ada) makes real Chrome follow the same rule, and it gates the cut either way.

Evidence: L1 (prose only: the markdown rendered with the Portal's renderer, every link target checked) → L4 required for AC-3's rendered Portal (the 13.2 Pages build). Residual: AC-3, Residual-Owner: #14800.
